text:
Predicates:
Created(x, y) ::: x created the game y.
Japanese(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
Sells(x, y) ::: x sells more than y million copies.
Premises:
Created(japaneseGameCompany, legendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (Top10(x) → Japanese(x)) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (∃y (Sells(x, y) → Top10(x))) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be selected into the Top 10 list.
Sells(legendOfZelda, oneMillion) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
Japanese(fifa22) ::: FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
